+# ROADMAP: HVM (High-Bandwidth Vector Memory) content transport
+
+Goal: a hybrid workload that stages data in HVM (0x90000000) during the QEMU
+leg sees the same bytes in the vsim ROI, and the exit state carries the ROI's
+HVM writes back out -- same contract the ILM/DLM transport
+(ROADMAP_ilm_dlm.md, all DONE) established for the LM slave ports.
+
+## Established facts (verified 2026-07-10)
+
+- **DS220 map**: 0x90000000..0x9FFFFFFF = HVM Subordinate Port aperture
+  (256MB window); the actual memory is much smaller (engine config).
+- **QEMU model** (`hw/riscv/andes_ae350.c:1478-1489`): HVM = plain
+  `memory_region_init_ram` at `hvm_base` + a subport **alias of the same
+  RAM** at `hvm_subport_base` (defaults: both 0x90000000,
+  `andes_ae350.h:241-243`). Plain RAM, so unlike ILM/DLM there is NO
+  per-CPU overlay, NO enable bit, NO IO forwarder; the ELF loader CAN
+  write it and the plugin reads it with plain `read_memory_hwaddr`.
+- **QEMU default size is 1 BYTE**: `hvm_size_pow_2` defaults to 0
+  (`1 << 0`). Real geometry comes only from config:
+  - driver path: premium's `--print-qemu-config` ALREADY emits
+    `hvm_base=0x90000000` + `hvm_size_pow_2=18` (256KB) -> `-readconfig`.
+    Driver-side geometry sync is already done, for free.
+  - raw-harness path (tests/e2e.sh): needs `-global` sync like ILM/DLM,
+    but the property is `hvm_size_pow_2` with a LOG2 value, not bytes --
+    `lm_wire()` needs a variant.
+- **CSRs**: `mhvm_cfg` (0xFD0) / `mhvmb` (0xFD1) are CONST_RO, seeded by
+  QEMU from the soc props (`target/riscv/cpu.c:969-979`) and derived by
+  the engine from its config. Nothing to transport (already classified
+  in the CSR manifests). There is NO enable bit (no milmb analog).
+- **vsim premium RTL** (`Vax45mpv_premium config.inc`): 256KB HVM,
+  base 0x90000000, 2 banks, bank bit = addr[17] (bank0 = first 128KB,
+  bank1 = second 128KB), subport present (`NDS_IO_HVM_SUBP`). No ECC
+  defines. Verilator SRAM arrays (cluster level, NOT inside the core):
+  `ae350_vcpu_cluster_subsystem__DOT__u_ae350_hvm_ram_subsystem__DOT__
+  u_hvm{0,1}_ram__DOT__ram_inst__DOT__mem`, each
+  `VlUnpacked<VlWide<16>, 2048>` = 2048 rows x 64B = 128KB/bank.
+- **vsim platform** (`src/simulator.hpp:155-170`): interconnect routes
+  `{NDS_HVM_BASE, NDS_HVM_BASE + NDS_HVM_SIZE_KB*0x1000 - 1}` to the
+  CPU's `hvm_bfm` subordinate port. `*0x1000` looks like KB-math slop
+  (1MB window for a 256KB memory), but see Known altitude debt: the
+  ILM/DLM binding routes full fixed apertures too, so over-wide routing
+  is the platform's established style and no cheap test observes the
+  difference. Left as-is.
+- **ax46mpv_advanced**: config has HVM (256KB, 1 bank, RAM_TYPE 0) but
+  its wrapper has no backdoor (same status as its ILM/DLM). Capability
+  gating (`kCpuCanLoadHvm`/`kCpuCanDumpHvm`) makes it describe 0 -- the
+  F3-ax46-regression lesson is already encoded in the pattern.
+- **Content transport today: NONE.** QEMU's HVM RAM is not backed by the
+  shared mmap (separate init_ram), vsim's HVM SRAM resets to zeros, no
+  plugin sidecar / vsim CLI / driver wiring mention HVM. A workload
+  staging vector data in HVM pre-handoff reads zeros in the ROI.
+- Fixture header `tests/fixtures/runtime/memory_map.h` already has
+  `HVM_BASE 0x90000000`, `HVM_END 0x9003FFFF`, `TEST_HVM`.
+
+## Reusable machinery (from the LM transport)
+
+- plugin `drain_lm_sidecar(state_path, suffix, base, size)` is already
+  generic -- call it with `".hvm"`.
+- e2e.sh `lm_wire()` (needs a pow2 variant for the QEMU -global leg),
+  `CHECK_LM_EXIT_SIDECARS` byte-exact cmp, `hybrid_describe_int`.
+- vsim capability variable templates + describe gating + `--ilm/--dlm`

+  local v

+#include "runtime/memory_map.h"
+
+#include <stdint.h>
+#include <stdio.h>
+
+#define HVM_BYTES 262144u
+#define HVM_WORDS (HVM_BYTES / 4u)
+#define WIN_WORDS 64u
+
+/* Per-word pattern: cheap, position-dependent, never all-zero. */
+static inline uint32_t pat(uint32_t i) { return i * 2654435761u + 0x5A17u; }
+
+/* Copy n words out of the HVM through the VECTOR unit (vle32 loads the
+ * aperture, vse32 spills to a DRAM buffer for the scalar compare). Like
+ * rt_c_v_fill, v8 is used without a clobber: -O1 never touches V regs. */
+static void v_copy_words(uint32_t src_word, uint32_t *dst, uint32_t n)
+{
+  const uint32_t *src =
+    (const uint32_t *) (uintptr_t) (HVM_BASE + src_word * 4u);
+  while (n) {
+    unsigned long vl;
+    asm volatile("vsetvli %0, %1, e32, m1, ta, ma\n\t"
+                 "vle32.v v8, (%2)\n\t"
+                 "vse32.v v8, (%3)"
+                 : "=&r"(vl)
+                 : "r"((unsigned long) n), "r"(src), "r"(dst)
+                 : "memory");
+    src += vl;
+    dst += vl;
+    n -= (uint32_t) vl;
+  }
+}
+
+/* Returns the number of mismatching words in [w0, w0+WIN_WORDS). */
+static uint32_t check_window(uint32_t w0)
+{
+  uint32_t buf[WIN_WORDS];
+  v_copy_words(w0, buf, WIN_WORDS);
+  uint32_t bad = 0;
+  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < WIN_WORDS; i++)
+    if (buf[i] != pat(w0 + i)) bad++;
+  return bad;
+}
+
+int main(void)
+{
+  volatile uint32_t *hvm = (volatile uint32_t *) (uintptr_t) HVM_BASE;
+
+  /* QEMU phase: runtime-computed fill of the whole window. Also init stdio
+   * here so the ROI's verdict printf does not pay first-call setup. */
+  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < HVM_WORDS; i++) hvm[i] = pat(i);
+  printf("HVM filled\n");
+  fflush(stdout);
+
+  enter_vsim();
+
+  /* vsim ROI: sampled vector readback. Window starts: bank0 head, the
+   * bank boundary straddle (32 words each side of word 32768), bank1
+   * tail. */
+  uint32_t bad = 0;
+  bad += check_window(0);
+  bad += check_window(HVM_WORDS / 2u - WIN_WORDS / 2u);
+  bad += check_window(HVM_WORDS - WIN_WORDS);
+  if (bad == 0) {
+    printf("HVM_OK sampled=%u\n", (unsigned) (3 * WIN_WORDS));
+  } else {
+    printf("HVM_BAD count=%u\n", (unsigned) bad);
+  }
+  fflush(stdout);
+
+  exit_vsim();
+
+  return bad != 0;
+}

## Altitude review — HVM transport

Overall verdict: the **config/plumbing layer generalized well** (the shared choke points were reused, HVM is genuinely "+1" there). The **codec layer grew a parallel implementation** instead of subsuming the existing one, and the **"lm" naming did not keep up** with the semantic broadening. The cross-layer triplication is real and is the rule-of-three trigger, but it is faithful copy-extension of an established pattern and is acceptable to ship as documented debt.

### Where the altitude is RIGHT (reused shared infra — no action)
- **Plugin drain** (`hybrid_handoff.c:481` `drain_lm_sidecar(base,size,suffix)`): already generic; HVM is one extra call at the single choke point (`:517`) plus two config args. Correct depth.
- **Driver `run_plan.cpp`** (gate/suffix/argv, `:139-152/:210-221`), **describe field**, and **capability gates** `kCpuCanLoad/DumpHvm` (`simulator.hpp:54-58`): HVM is a faithful +1 on a data-driven pattern. Correct.
- **Engine-specific geometry stayed localized**: the 2-bank / bit-17 hierarchical refs live only in the premium wrapper's `set_hvm/get_hvm` and are pinned by `static_assert(_NDS_HVM_BANKS==2 && 2*bank_bytes==SIZE)` (`ax45mpv_premium…hpp:649`). No HVM bank knowledge leaked upward. Correct.

### Findings

**A. `lm_geom` hardcodes one kind's identity to pick property name + encoding**
- File/line: `andesim/tests/e2e.sh:144` (`if [ "$1" = hvm ]`)
- Why altitude is wrong: a kind-agnostic helper (takes `$1`) special-cases the literal string `hvm` to switch BOTH the QEMU property name (`hvm_size_pow_2` vs `<kind>_size`) AND the value encoding (log2 vs bytes). Two divergence axes collapsed onto one identity check — a future pow2 memory with a different property name re-breaks the branch.
- Deeper fix: key on the *attribute*, not the identity — a tiny per-kind table (kind → property-name, pow2?) or pass those two as args. Then `hvm` is data, not a branch.
- Debt call: acceptable at 3 kinds / 1 divergence; the table earns its keep at kind #4 or divergence #2. A per-kind property table is indeed cleaner but not yet warranted.

**B. Adding a memory kind is a parallel edit across ~8 files, not a registration**
- File/lines: `engine_descriptor.hpp:35/76`, `run_plan.cpp:139-152/210-221`, `hybrid_handoff.c:331-336/509-517/707-713`, `elf_loader.hpp` MEM_TYPE, `simulator.hpp` caps+dump+`load_image` case (`:565-566/:590-597`), `main.cpp` describe/longopt/load/help, `e2e.sh:158-163/598`.
- Why altitude is wrong: the enumeration `{ilm,dlm} → {ilm,dlm,hvm}` is copy-pasted per layer. A third kind is "eight files," not "one line." The `load_image` switch (`simulator.hpp:590`) and describe block grow O(kinds) of near-identical boilerplate.
- Deeper fix: a single memory-kind descriptor per repo (name, default base, describe-field, qemu-property+encoding, backdoor setter/getter) iterated by each layer; the switch/`if constexpr` cases become table entries.
- Debt call: **acceptable to ship** — every site is a 1–3 line faithful extension and the true choke points (`drain_lm_sidecar`, `CHECK_LM_EXIT_SIDECARS`, run_plan suffix) were reused rather than duplicated. But this IS the rule-of-three moment: kind #4 must be a table entry, not a 4th copy. The MEM_TYPE-switch growth specifically is acceptable boilerplate now.

**C. `hvm_bank_write/read` is a parallel codec to `lm_backdoor_read`, with an inline-vs-factored write asymmetry**
- File/lines: `ax45mpv_premium…hpp:30-55` (new `hvm_bank_write`/`hvm_bank_read`) vs `:57-76` (`lm_backdoor_read`); LM write loop inlined at `set_ilm:477-497` / `set_dlm:575-595`.
- Why altitude is wrong: read is now done two ways (LM: ECC-aware, scalar-or-VlWide[0]/[1]; HVM: no-ECC wide-lane). Worse, write is asymmetric — LM inlines its byte-assembly loop in each setter while HVM factors `hvm_bank_write`. The little-endian byte↔word assembly idiom is hand-written ~5× (set_ilm, set_dlm, hvm_bank_write, and inverse in lm_backdoor_read, hvm_bank_read).
- Deeper fix: share one LE `bytes↔word` primitive pair used by both families; layer ECC-gen on top for LM writes only. Full codec unification is legitimately blocked (hvm_bank_read indexes `mem[row][lane]`, can't index a scalar-word LM row), so unify at the byte-assembly level, not the whole loop. At minimum, factor the LM write loop the way HVM's was factored, or drop a comment on why LM stays inline.
- Debt call: two codec families is not yet rule-of-three for the codec itself, so separate impls are defensible — but the write asymmetry is gratuitous and should be reconciled cheaply now.

**D. The "lm" name now carries a memory that is explicitly NOT local memory**
- File/lines: `drain_lm_sidecar` (`hybrid_handoff.c`), `lm_geom`/`lm_wire`/`QEMU_LM_ARGS`/`VSIM_LM_ARGS`/`CHECK_LM_EXIT_SIDECARS` (`e2e.sh`), `dump_lm_sidecars` (`simulator.hpp:553`).
- Why altitude is wrong: the diff and `ROADMAP_hvm.md` repeatedly stress HVM is a *cluster* memory with no enable bit and a different aperture — architecturally not an LM — yet it now flows through ~7 identifiers named `lm`. The name no longer describes the contents; readers will assume `dump_lm_sidecars`/`drain_lm_sidecar` are local-memory-only.
- Deeper fix: rename the shared machinery `lm_* → mem_*` (mechanical, cheap).
- Debt call: `ROADMAP_hvm.md:175` defers the rename to "a third user," but these generic helpers now have **three callers (ilm/dlm/hvm)** and one is semantically not-LM — by the caller count the trigger has fired; by the "family" count it hasn't. That ambiguity itself is worth resolving: the semantic breakage (non-LM carried by `lm_*`) is the real trigger and it is present now. Either rename or fix the ROADMAP note so the deferral criterion is unambiguous.

### Note on the ROADMAP's own debt ledger
`ROADMAP_hvm.md` already self-documents two items honestly: the `simulator.hpp` 1MB routing window for a 256KB memory (`:167`, matches the ILM/DLM full-aperture style — fine to defer) and the `lm_*` rename (`:175`). The rename criterion is the one that is arguably already met (Finding D); the routing-window deferral is well-justified and I'd leave it.
